description: tus 1.0.0 at /tus/ with the core, creation and termination extensions, when the files are on a drive (storage "disk"); with a bucket /tus/ is 404 and uploads go through /api/s3/uploads. Authenticate every request (PIN cookie or Authorization: Bearer). Upload ids are file ids.

create.notes: Location is always a path; resolve it against the address in use. Metadata keys filename/filetype (or name/type), lastModified (Unix ms) and folder are read; others are dropped. folder is the id of the folder a signed-in phone or browser sends into, and they must say it (400 bad_request without): one they see, else 404 folder_gone; someone who sees no folder gets 403 no_folder. A PIN's uploads always go into the PIN's folder, whatever folder says. Into an encrypted folder (docs/e2ee-plan.md), Upload-Length is the encrypted size and Upload-Metadata has enc: JSON with the version of the folder's key that the file key is sealed for, the sealed key, the header and the plain size, as in s3_upload_create_encrypted.json; the same errors as there. Into an encrypted folder (docs/e2ee-plan.md), Upload-Length is the encrypted size and Upload-Metadata has enc: JSON with the version of the folder's key that the file key is sealed for, the sealed key, the header and the plain size, as in s3_upload_create_encrypted.json; the same errors as there.

patch.notes: Keep each PATCH at or below chunk_size_bytes from /api/info (Cloudflare rejects bodies over 100 MB). The last PATCH also carries Share-File-Id.

head_finished.notes: A finished upload keeps answering HEAD with offset == length, so a client that lost the final response knows it is done.
